physical.mounting-hardware: Hex bolt x3, nut x3, washer x6 and split washer x3 (instruction sheet); midspan bracket x3

base.description: The manager as APC ships AR8625, both doors fitted.

doors-off.description: The same manager with both doors taken off, the finger columns and the channels open to lay a cable in. The doors come with the manager, so this is an illustration and not a device type.

datasheet.title: Performance, Vertical Cable Manager for 2 & 4 Post Racks, 84"H x 6"W, Double-Sided with Doors (AR8625), product data sheet

description: Double-sided vertical cable manager, 6 in wide, APC Performance AR8625 for 2 and 4 post open frame racks: a steel back plate 2134 mm tall with a cable channel on both faces, a column of 44 smooth plastic fingers down each side of each channel, a finger to each rack unit, and a full-length door with two quarter-turn latches over each face that ships fitted. It stands beside the rack on three hex bolts through the upright and takes no rack unit.

gaps.note: each door "opens to left or right" on hinge pins and lifts off; the instruction sheet shows a quarter-turn latch and a door swinging off the finger tips either way, but no view dimensions a hinge. Each door is drawn as one fitted plate that is either on or off.
gaps.wanted: a drawing or a close render of the door's hinge pins and latch

gaps.note: the data sheet advertises "multiple internal cable tie-off locations". The instruction sheet draws the slots and punches in the central plate that they are, but dimensions none, and the format has no place to state a tie point on a duct (#1009 states them only on the FS tray). They are not drawn or stated.
gaps.wanted: the plate's slots dimensioned, and a place in the format for a duct's tie points

gaps.note: the instruction sheet shows an optional grounding and bonding point, a tab with a hole bent up at the foot of the plate, "Hardware and cable not provided". No thread or hole size is stated, and a grounding point in the format is a stud or screw with a thread, so none is stated.
gaps.wanted: the size of the hole and the screw it takes

gaps.note: APC states "high capacity" and no figure on the data sheet, the instruction sheet or the brochure, so none is recorded and none is estimated.
gaps.wanted: a capacity figure and the cable it is stated for

gaps.note: the instruction sheet's isometric figure draws each finger as a smooth tongue with a rolled root. It is built as an arm 12 across and a hooked tip 22 across, 31 high, 296 long; the size, the length and the count (44, counted at constant pitch on the single-sided figure) are read off a figure that is not dimensioned.
gaps.wanted: a section through a finger and the back plate

gaps.note: where the first finger stands against the rack's units is not stated: the fingers are centred on the 2134 mm height, and which hole of the upright each bolt takes is not dimensioned, so whether they sit on the rack's units is not known.
gaps.wanted: the heights of the three bolt holes against the rack's first unit

gaps.note: three midspan brackets ship with the part and divide the interior space between the two channels (the brochure: 40-60, 50-50 or 60-40); the spine between the channels is drawn as a 60 mm plate zone and the brackets are not drawn, nor is the division moved by them.
gaps.wanted: the bracket (AR8681 is its 6 in spare) dimensioned

gaps.note: the doors have an oval opening near their top in the instruction sheet's figure; it is not drawn.
how far the manager stands from the upright when it is bolted on is not dimensioned; the part is drawn alone.
gaps.wanted: a dimensioned drawing of the manager fitted to an upright

body.description: the back plates and their wells, the front first

doors.description: the full-length doors, front first, shipped fitted

fingers.description: the sections of 11 fingers, left then right, top to bottom; the front channel first

name: ar8625

attrs.note: datasheet - the colour, the plastic fingers, the hardware (three hex bolts, nuts and washers, split washers), the provided doors, installation guide and three midspan brackets, UL Listed and EU RoHS compliant are the data sheet and the instruction sheet.

bottom.note: estimated - the top view again: the two ends of the manager are alike.

capacity.note: datasheet - the AR8625 data sheet and the brochure state no cable capacity, only "high capacity". None is estimated here (see `gaps`).

chassis.note: datasheet - 152 x 2134 x 660, doors fitted: "Width 6.0 in (152 mm)", "Height 84.02 in (2134 mm)", "Depth 26.0 in (660 mm)".

color.note: estimated - "Color: Black". Every image APC publishes of the part is a render; it is drawn black, the doors a shade lighter than the back plate.

depth.note: estimated - the 660 is the data sheet's. It is drawn as two wells of 300 and a 60 back plate zone between them: the single-sided AR8615 is 14.2 in (360 mm), one well and a back plate zone, and the two figures solve to 300 and 60. No view sections the part.

front.note: estimated - the front face with its door fitted: the door, and under it the back plate with 44 fingers a side in four sections of 11, centred on the height. The `duct` guide is the channel between the two finger columns, run down the height, ESTIMATED from the instruction sheet's figure.

guides.note: estimated - each duct is the channel between the two finger columns of its face, run down the height (`run: y`). The finger pitch is the rack unit, 44.45, as the data sheet's "1U increments"; the gap is the pitch less the 31 mm finger, 13.45, ESTIMATED from the finger's drawn thickness.

left.note: estimated - no side view of the manager without its doors is dimensioned: the back plate between the two finger zones, built from the plan and the finger columns' extent.

method.note: FIGURES FROM THE MAKER'S OWN DOCUMENTS, read as data: the AR8625 product data sheet (fetched from se.com), the instruction sheet 990-4576A-001 (1/2016), which covers all six parts and draws the double-sided one, and the brochure "Enclosure and Rack Systems, Cable Management". THE FIGURES THE DATA SHEET PRINTS ARE `datasheet`; EVERYTHING READ OFF THE INSTRUCTION SHEET'S FIGURES (the fingers' count and size, the doors, the split of the depth) IS ESTIMATED and said so in the part that carries it. APC publishes no drawing or CAD for these parts. No drawing or photograph is copied. The part is the single-sided AR8615 on both faces of one back plate (see ar8615).

mount.note: datasheet - `rack-side`: "Mounting Mode: Not rack-mountable" on the data sheet, and the instruction sheet "Vertical Cable Manager Installation for Open Frame Racks" (990-4576A-001) bolts it to the side of the rack's upright with three hex bolts, nuts and washers. It occupies no rack unit. `ru: 44` is the rack height it runs beside: the data sheet's 84.02 in (2134 mm) is the whole part, top and bottom brackets included, and the fingers are 44 rack units; 44 is the height of the AR203A and one short of the AR201's 45, so one figure places it beside either (lint L154 judges a part by `ru`). Which side of the rack is a lab placement to say (docs/vertical-cable-managers-design.md).

rear.note: estimated - the rear face, the same parts placed the same way: the instruction sheet's figure draws the finger columns and a door on each side of the central plate, and the data sheet says "double-sided cable channel". `rear-duct` is the rear channel.

right.note: estimated - the left view turned round.

shell.note: estimated - TWO HOLLOW CHANNELS BACK TO BACK, NOT A BOX. The body is a sheet body and its six views are elevations; the solid is what its parts build: on each face the back plate as a well 300 deep, its 88 fingers standing off its floor and a door over their tips, which pulls off and opens the channel.

thickness.note: estimated - no APC document states a gauge. 1.5 is a sheet of this kind; the parts carry their own thicknesses.

top.note: estimated - the plan, rear at y=0: the rear fingers, the back plate zone and the front fingers, from the finger length above.

weight.note: datasheet - "Net Weight 65.9 lb(US) (29.9 kg)"; packed 39 kg.
